purpose: Let the artist set a real Song suggestion aside without seeing the same idea again during the same work Session, while allowing a later Session to reconsider it.

lineage.outcome: The artist can say Not now to a concrete Song suggestion and N0TE remembers that choice for the current work Session.

observed_gap.proof: Repository search and direct implementation inspection found suggestion creation and stable semantic keys, but no Not now consumer action or persisted suggestion suppression.

implementation_contract.scope: exact Song plus latest work Session plus stable suggestion semantic key
implementation_contract.resurfacing: a later Session does not inherit the prior Session deferral
implementation_contract.authority: Not now records attention preference only; it grants no provider, DAW or execution authority
implementation_contract.security: same exact Host, Origin, CSRF and one-shot protections as suggestion creation

completion_proof: consumer result exposes one protected Not now action
deferral survives process relaunch for the same Song and Session
deferred semantic key is excluded from later suggestions in that Session
new Session does not inherit old Session suppression
stale Song or Session result fails closed
semantic keys remain absent from rendered markup
full regression and staged consumer smoke pass at the exact head; cross-platform hosted evidence remains required for closure
next_selection_rule: Do not select adjacent suggestion work. Close only after exact-head required evidence; otherwise preserve this bounded receipt as ACTIVE or BLOCKED with the precise missing evidence.
